source_caption:
🎬 A Better Life (2011)

A Better Life follows Carlos Galindo, a hardworking undocumented immigrant living in Los Angeles who struggles to provide a better future for his teenage son, Luis. Working long hours as a gardener, Carlos dreams of giving his son opportunities he never had while trying to keep him away from the dangers of neighborhood gangs and street violence. When Carlos finally gets the chance to purchase his own gardening truck and equipment, he believes his life is about to change for the better. However, an unexpected setback threatens everything he has worked for, forcing father and son to embark on an emotional journey that tests their relationship and determination. Starring Demián Bichir and José Julián, the film delivers a powerful story about fatherhood, sacrifice, immigration, family, and the American Dream.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 38m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Chris Weitz

✍️ Writer: Eric Eason

🏆 Awards: Demián Bichir received an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor.

source_details.synopsis: A Better Life is a 2011 American drama film directed by Chris Weitz and written by Eric Eason, based on a story by Roger L. Simon. It stars Demián Bichir as an undocumented immigrant gardener in Los Angeles who, along with his teenage son, attempts to find his stolen truck. The film received a limited release in the United States on June 24, 2011, by Summit Entertainment. For his performance, Bichir was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actor.
